shortDescription: Manage bandwidth resource control and priority for protocols, services and zones on Solaris/illumos systems

options.name: dsfield
options.description: - Identifies the 8-bit differentiated services field (as defined in RFC 2474). The optional dsfield_mask is used to state the bits of interest in the differentiated services field when comparing with the dsfield value. Both values must be in hexadecimal.

options.name: link
options.description: Specifiies a link to configure flow on.

options.name: local_ip
options.description: Identifies a network flow by the local IP address.

options.name: local_port
options.description: Identifies a service specified by the local port.

options.name: maxbw
options.description: - Sets the full duplex bandwidth for the flow. The bandwidth is specified as an integer with one of the scale suffixes(K, M, or G for Kbps, Mbps, and Gbps). If no units are specified, the input value will be read as Mbps.

options.name: name
options.description: - A flow is defined as a set of attributes based on Layer 3 and Layer 4 headers, which can be used to identify a protocol, service, or a zone.

options.name: priority
options.description: Sets the relative priority for the flow.

options.name: remote_ip
options.description: Identifies a network flow by the remote IP address.

options.name: state
options.description: Create/delete/enable/disable an IP address on the network interface.

options.name: temporary
options.description: Specifies that the configured flow is temporary. Temporary flows do not persist across reboots.

options.name: transport
options.description: - Specifies a Layer 4 protocol to be used. It is typically used in combination with I(local_port) to identify the service that needs special attention.
